about.description_text: MyFitnessPlan is a self-hosted, personal workout planning tool that helps you organize and track custom workout routines using your own video resources. Unlike rigid, predefined weekly schedules, MyFitnessPlan lets you define custom workout patterns that fit your lifestyle.
about.license_text: This project is licensed under a Non-Commercial Use License. You are free to use, modify, and share this software for personal projects.
about.non_commercial: This is a free, open-source, self-hosted project. Feel free to use it and
about.feature_custom_patterns: Define your own custom workout patterns
about.feature_local_videos: Link to your local video files
about.feature_privacy: 100% private - data stays on your computer

import.title: Add videos from YouTube
import.intro: Paste a link to a YouTube playlist. It becomes its own album in your library, and you can rename it afterwards.
import.note: These play from YouTube with ads and need an internet connection. There is no file on your computer, but you can still tag them like your own videos.
import.done_truncated: Imported the first {{count}} videos — the playlist was longer than that.
import.error_unavailable: YouTube import isn't available in this version of the app.
import.error_unsupported_url: That doesn't look like a YouTube link.
import.error_not_found: Couldn't open that playlist. Check it isn't private, and that the link is right.
import.error_empty: That playlist has no playable videos in it.
import.error_failed: Couldn't read that playlist. Check the link and your internet connection.
import.public_warning: The playlist must be Public or Unlisted. YouTube blocks private playlists, so those can't be imported.

ai.builder_intro: Describe what you want and the AI will draft a plan from your own video library.
ai.builder_note: The draft opens in the normal plan builder, so you can change anything before saving.
ai.describe_label: What do you want from this plan?
ai.describe_placeholder: e.g. I want to lose weight and tone my legs. I live upstairs so nothing with jumping. Mornings, before work.
ai.equipment_hint: Videos needing anything you haven't selected are left out. Select nothing to allow everything.
ai.albums_hint: Click once to use only that album, again to leave it out. Leave all untouched to use the whole library.
ai.generating_hint: This can take up to a minute. The plan will open in the builder when it's ready.
ai.dropped_notice: {{count}} suggested video(s) were not in your library and have been left out.
ai.truncated_notice: Your library is large, so the {{count}} best-matching videos were considered.
ai.error_generic: The model could not build a plan. Try again or adjust your settings.
ai.settings_msg: Add an API key to unlock AI plan building. Everything stays off until you do.
ai.base_url_hint: Point this at a local runtime such as Ollama or LM Studio to keep everything on your machine.
ai.model_from_provider: This list comes from your provider, so the names are always current.
ai.model_typing: Typing a name by hand — it must match exactly, including capitals.
ai.model_hint: Save your key to load the list of models your provider offers.
ai.key_stored: A key is saved — type to replace it
ai.key_hint: Stored on this computer only, and never shown again after saving.
ai.privacy_note: When you generate a plan, your description and your videos' titles, tags and descriptions are sent to the provider you chose. Video files are never uploaded, and nothing is sent unless you press Generate.
ai.clean_hint: Remove links, sponsor copy and other clutter. Tags are not changed.
ai.cleanup_album_hint: Remove links and clutter from every description in this album. Tags are not changed.
